title: Integral quotient fibre identifies with closed fibre
statement:
theorem closed_fibre_is_integral
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [ValuationRing A]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of A))
    [IsProper f] [Flat f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (hX₀ : IsIntegral (Limits.pullback f (Spec.map
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)))))) :
    IsIntegral (f.fiber (IsLocalRing.closedPoint A))

source.place: More on Morphisms, Lemma 0EX8, general-case proof

proof.text: Use Ideal.bijective_algebraMap_quotient_residueField at the maximal ideal to form a ring equivalence A/m ≃ κ(m). Apply Spec and pullback.map to obtain an isomorphism of its pullback with the quotient pullback. Use Scheme.Spec.map_residueFieldIso_inv_eq_fromSpecResidueField and a second pullback.map isomorphism to compare the scheme-theoretic closed fibre. Transport IsIntegral from the quotient pullback using IsIntegral.of_isIso on the inverse composite.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0EX8, general-case identification κ = A/m; direct Mathlib residue-field and pullback comparison
